title: paper_v2 event_id columns: source bigint vs archive TEXT type drift
description: Several source paper_v2 event_id columns are bigint (sequence-generated), while archive declares TEXT. Considered acceptable since TEXT is a strict superset and preserves all values. T14b handler must cast bigint → str at archive time (str(int) is canonical). Test coverage required to ensure no precision loss for bigint values >= 2^53 (JS-safe int boundary, conservative). Decision needed: prefix-or-not for archive-side ids (e.g. 'evt_'+str(bigint) vs raw str(bigint)). Deferred design pass from round-2.
required_verification: T14b handler cast tests covering bigint at int64 max boundary
Decision recorded for prefix vs raw int-as-string
closure_requirements: Casting policy documented in handler design doc
T14b implementation includes idempotent cast tests
